description: A status poll asks what a session's subagents are doing, and the answers land in a closed-set `state` column and a `children` column. `ready for decommissioning` is a `doing` value and never a state, which is the thing a table with a state column invites you to get wrong.

turns.prompt: Poll the three sessions for status.

graders.name: reads the coordinator-sessions skill before the first session action
graders.rule: When a session's state is in question, poll it; do not ask the user.

graders.name: the poll asks what their subagents are doing
the poll asks for a state from the closed set
nothing is written before the answers arrive

turns.prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/111.sock" from-name="wt-audit" from-mode="prompting">
Auditing the upload handler, working. Waiting on nobody. Free at 15:00. Not blocked. Robin said TDD and no pushes. Two subagents running: path-sweep is checking every route, fixture-builder is idle waiting on me.
</cross-session-message>

<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/222.sock" from-name="7719-fixer" from-mode="prompting">
Release notes drafted, nothing in flight. Waiting on Robin for the wording of the security section. Free now. Not blocked. Standing constraint: one stage then pause. No subagents.
</cross-session-message>

<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/333.sock" from-name="4821-notes" from-mode="prompting">
The notes index migration is finished and I am ready for decommissioning. Waiting on nobody. Free now. Not blocked. No constraints. No subagents.
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: the working session's state is recorded
the waiting session names who it waits on
a session with no subagents says so rather than leaving it blank
ready for decommissioning is not written as a state
it is recorded in doing, where it belongs
Log times are this move's clock reads
